g.text: BrewLite A2 - Sequence: UC-04 Checkout (VNPay sandbox)
Select WALLET or CARD; press Pay with VNPay
Disable button; generate Idempotency-Key (no card field)
Retry POST /orders with SAME cart (no existing orderId)
Fix cart; no Order created; stop checkout
Transaction T1: recipe locks, ingredient reservation, snapshot (FR-11/13; NFR-13)
BEGIN; read Product prices and options
ROLLBACK; no Order or balance change
Lock recipes by ID (FOR SHARE); read base + topping RecipeLines
Lock Ingredient rows by ID (FOR UPDATE); read balances
Aggregate tracked ingredient demand across ALL cart lines
demand(i) = sum of cart quantity x (base + selected topping quantities for i).
Only tracked=true ingredients enter demand and the immutable snapshot.
[Missing/invalid recipe or no tracked base ingredient (E2)]
ROLLBACK (no Order, OrderItem, snapshot or balance change)
ROLLBACK (no Order, OrderItem, snapshot or balance change)
Keep cart; report changed ingredients; link to edit cart
[All recipes valid and aggregate demand fits]
Persist orderId/owner/key to continue same order
Only the successful POST /orders branch continues to payment.
UC-04.2 (1/3): create Payment PENDING and signed VNPay URL
HTTP calls to VNPay (QueryDR) are always made OUTSIDE any DB transaction that holds the Order lock.
Signing the payment URL is local HMAC-SHA512; it needs no network call.
401 UNAUTHORIZED; no Payment or new Order
Re-login SAME account; retain cart, orderId and key
Verify owner and load current order
Require original account or show current order
Retry POST /payments SAME orderId and key (new JWT)
Read Order (no lock yet); verify owner (E7)
Explain error; keep cart; no Payment created
Lookup SUCCESS by owner + orderId + key + paymentMethod (BR-05)
Replay needs no signing, no VNPay configuration and no new Payment.
[E11: latest Payment PENDING is past expiresAt]
Outside any DB transaction; 10 s timeout
Verify response signature, merchant, TxnRef; amount for 00
Transaction T3: apply QueryDR result (same applyGatewayResult as IPN)
BEGIN; lock Order; re-read THAT Payment
If IPN finalized it meanwhile: keep DB state, discard stale result
Payment SUCCESS; if inventoryTracked=true: lock snapshot ingredients by ID
onHand -= snapshot; reserved -= snapshot; Order PAID; COMMIT
Payment FAILED (codes kept apart); Order PAYMENT_FAILED; COMMIT
[91 after expiry (verified), or grace elapsed without a verdict (D6)]
Payment FAILED, gatewayResponseCode="EXPIRED"; Order PAYMENT_FAILED; COMMIT
D6: now >= expiresAt + 15 min (isPastGrace) with 00/01, unsupported status,
another code, BAD_RESPONSE or no verified answer -> FAILED + "EXPIRED", warning PAYMENT_EXPIRED_UNCONFIRMED.
EXPIRED is an internal gatewayResponseCode, not a PaymentStatus.
[00/01 inside the grace, or 91 before expiry]
QueryDR 00/01 keeps PENDING only until expiresAt + 15 min,
then the branch above closes it. Closed only on a call; no background job.
[04/05/06/07/09 or MISMATCH (never auto-closed), or an unanswered query inside the grace]
ROLLBACK; DB unchanged; warning if money may have moved
MISMATCH applies to a signed 00 response only. Any other code (91 too) with a wrong or
missing merchant or TxnRef is BAD_RESPONSE: 502 inside the grace, closed after it.
[Same owner + orderId + key + paymentMethod (BR-05 checked FIRST)]
409 PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS; no new URL, no new Payment (BR-10)
"Checking payment" with Check again button; do not advise paying twice
[QueryDR failed inside the grace: network, signature or configuration (E13)]
502 PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ERROR; DB and Order unchanged (past the grace the Payment is closed, D6)
Generic error; keep cart and orderId
200 SAME paymentUrl + expiresAt, even with a new key
Continue the existing payment or check status
[No open Payment: create a new attempt]
Generic error; keep cart and orderId
vnp_TxnRef=Payment.id; vnp_Amount=amount x 100; GMT+7 create/expire dates (+15 min)
Transaction T2: Payment PENDING (no HTTP call inside this lock)
BEGIN; lock Order; re-read open Payment (BR-10)
INSERT Payment(PENDING, paymentUrl, expiresAt, gatewayCreateDate, idempotencyKey)
UPDATE Order PAYMENT_FAILED -> PENDING (snapshot kept; no new reservation)
COMMIT T2; one Payment PENDING; Order PENDING
Save { orderId, key, paymentId, paymentMethod } in sessionStorage; keep cart
[A6: Customer returns to checkout while the Payment PENDING is still valid]
UC-04.2 (2/3): customer pays on VNPay; IPN
Enter NCB test card and OTP on the VNPay page
Check VNP configuration; verify HMAC-SHA512 signature and vnp_TmnCode
{"RspCode":"99"}; no DB read or write; VNPay retries later
BEGIN; lock Order; re-read Payment and Order
[Payment not PENDING, or Order not PENDING]
[E12: success IPN after FAILED / EXPIRED, CANCELLED order, or paid by another Payment]
Staff checks Merchant Admin and refunds by hand
(a repeated IPN for an already successful Payment only gets 02)
UPDATE Payment SUCCESS (gatewayTxnNo, bankCode, paidAt, both gateway codes)
If inventoryTracked=true: lock snapshot ingredients by ID (FOR UPDATE)
onHand -= snapshot; reserved -= snapshot; UPDATE Order -> PAID; COMMIT
IPN counts as failed when vnp_TransactionStatus = 02,
including a customer Cancel (vnp_ResponseCode 24) and an OTP-step timeout (15).
UPDATE Payment FAILED (gatewayResponseCode, gatewayTransactionStatus kept apart)
UPDATE Order -> PAYMENT_FAILED; onHand, reserved and snapshot unchanged; COMMIT
[Status 01, reversal/refund group, unsupported or conflicting codes]
{"RspCode":"99"}; warning if money may have moved
UC-04.2 (3/3): return page, polling and optional QueryDR
Load return page (display only; never decides the result, BR-11)
[Invalid signature/merchant, unknown Payment or configuration missing (E9/E13)]
{ valid:false }; no IDs taken from the unverified query
Recover only orderId/paymentId stored in this customer's sessionStorage
[every 2 s, at most 30 s, until a final state]
Order status; payments with paymentUrl, expiresAt, gateway codes
[E10: Payment still PENDING (IPN lost or late: Render asleep, or local run with no IPN)]
POST /payments/:id/sync (JWT; one call, no retry loop)
200 { paymentId, orderId, orderStatus, status } from DB; no QueryDR
POST querydr (outside any DB transaction; 10 s timeout)
Verify response signature, merchant, TxnRef; amount for 00
[Inside the grace: network/timeout, bad or missing signature (UNSIGNED), config missing, BAD_RESPONSE or another query code (E13)]
[MISMATCH of a 00 response (wrong amount, merchant, TxnRef or type), or 00 with 04/05/06/07/09 (never auto-closed)]
[Grace elapsed (now >= expiresAt + 15 min) with no verdict: 00/01, unsupported status, another code, BAD_RESPONSE or no verified answer (D6, E11)]
BEGIN; lock Order; re-read THAT Payment; if still PENDING:
Payment FAILED, gatewayResponseCode="EXPIRED"; Order PAYMENT_FAILED; COMMIT
Transaction T3: applyGatewayResult (same function as IPN; mapping of E11)
BEGIN; lock Order; re-read THAT Payment; keep the DB state if IPN already finalized it
Payment SUCCESS; if inventoryTracked=true: lock snapshot ingredients by ID
onHand -= snapshot; reserved -= snapshot (once); Order PAID; COMMIT
[Not concluded inside the grace: 00/01, or 91 before expiry (91 after expiry: see E11)]
[DB says Order PAID / PREPARING / READY / COMPLETED]
Clear cart and checkout session of exactly this order
Show paid receipt, order code, tracking (FR-20)
Failure message by response code (24 cancelled, 11/15/EXPIRED expired, 51 insufficient funds, other generic)
Keep cart and orderId; offer Retry (A3, back to POST /payments) or Cancel (A5)
"Checking payment, please check again"; Check again button
Never advise paying a second time
UC-06: owner cancellation of unpaid order (FR-25 Must)
Verify owner; read Order and its latest Payment (no lock held)
[E11: latest Payment PENDING is past expiresAt]
BEGIN; lock Order; re-read THAT Payment; apply the E11 mapping; COMMIT
BEGIN; lock Order; re-read Payment; check owner and transition
[Payment PENDING within expiresAt, or still unresolved (A5 blocked)]
Explain payment in progress; continue (A6) or check status
[Valid unpaid order, inventoryTracked=true, no unresolved Payment]
Lock snapshot ingredients by ID (FOR UPDATE); reserved -= snapshot
Keep onHand unchanged; set CANCELLED; COMMIT
Restore original Product.stock quantities; set CANCELLED; COMMIT
Legacy inventoryTracked=false: successful payment changes no inventory balances;
owner cancellation restores original Product.stock quantities.
New true-marker orders use snapshot, never current recipes for consume/release.
Ingredients are released only by owner cancellation, never because a Payment became FAILED/EXPIRED.
No automatic cancellation or reservation expiry.
